name: 7-Eleven Gold Pass
description: Gold Pass membership for $5.95/month or $55/year (up to 40% off) for students, EBT card holders, and other verified community members; 30-day free trial
fullDescription: 7-Eleven is one of the world's largest convenience store chains. Their Gold Pass membership offers free drinks, fuel savings, $0 delivery fees, and member-only deals, with up to 40% off for students, EBT card holders, and other verified community members.
whatTheyOffer:
- Gold Pass regularly $9.95/month or $95/year
- Up to 40% off ($5.95/month or $55/year) for students, EBT card holders, and other ID.me-verified community members (such as military and veterans)
- 7 free drinks per month (coffee, Big Gulp, or Slurpee; 1 per day)
- Extra 5¢/gallon off fuel at participating locations
- $0 delivery fee on 7NOW orders and 10% back in 7-Eleven Cash
- 30-day free trial
howToGetIt:
1. Download the 7-Eleven or 7NOW app on your smartphone
2. Create an account or sign in
3. Open the Gold Pass hub or 'Community Discounts' in your profile
4. Verify your eligibility with ID.me (students, EBT card holders, military, and other communities)
5. Start your discounted membership
keywords: 7-Eleven, Gold Pass, EBT, SNAP, military, veteran, student, discount membership, convenience store, app, community discounts, ID.me, free drinks, delivery
